title: Hybrid 190: Run + Strength
author: Kevin Anthony
desc: Elevate your fitness game with the Hybrid 190: Run + Strength program, designed for those seeking a balanced approach to training. Over the course of one week, you'll engage in three dynamic workouts that combine strength training and running, ensuring you build muscle while enhancing your cardiovascular endurance. Each session lasts about 60 minutes and includes a variety of exercises targeting major muscle groups, making it perfect for intermediate lifters ready to push their limits. Equip yourself with a full gym and get ready to transform your fitness journey!
